玉箫来得很快，面上冷冰冰，眼底却有一缕担忧，他直接掠过林一一，坐到时笙旁边，“小殊，你醒了……有什么不适的地方和师父说。”

声音犹如珠玉滚落盘，十分悦耳，语气中却有些生硬淡漠，似乎不知道该用什么语气和她说话。

玉箫看上去很年轻，面容俊美，眉眼如画，周身散发着一股生人勿进的冰冷气息，禁欲系师父。

商殊是不是傻！

尼玛这师父这么好看，竟然放着不要，去折腾那个什么楚夜。

真是珠玉里面挑王八啊！

时笙移开视线，微微摇头，“没有不适。”

“没有就好。”玉箫依旧面无表情，“这次的事，你吃了教训，以后别在去招惹叶清秋。”

作为女配不招惹女主，可能吗？

“徒儿记住了。”就算要找女主麻烦，肯定不能告诉玉箫。

自家在外向来比较叛逆的徒儿忽然这么听话，玉箫眸子里闪过一丝诧异，但也只当她是这次受了教训，没有往深处想。

“师尊，这事就这么算了？”林一一不忿的开口，“我亲眼看到是叶清秋动手的……”

“一一！”一直站在林一一旁边的男子制止她在说下去。

“师父……”为什么不让她说？明明就是叶清秋动手，才把师叔害成这个样子的。

那个男子是商殊的师兄，白琅。

玉箫作为天尽峰的峰主，可以收两名亲传弟子，在没遇到商殊之前，他就收了白琅这么一个亲传弟子，后来将商殊捡回来，才收了商殊。

是的，商殊是被玉箫捡回来的。

林一一则是白琅的徒弟，比她还要小一辈。

“不要打扰小殊休息，都下去吧。”玉箫神色淡然的挥手，“考核的事，你们切记不要在外多说。”

“是，师尊。”林一一略带哀怨的看了自家师父一眼，随后转回时笙身上，“师叔，你好好养伤。”

林一一师徒离开后，玉箫顶着那张面无表情的俊脸，象征性的说了时笙几句，这才离开。

时笙重重的吐出一口浊气，之前两个位面，原主都是属于被炮灰的女配，而这个位面，她已经是自己作死的女配。

所以随着后面的位面，会越来也越难？

这个位面崩的人设明显是女主，叶清秋前世是元婴大能，被人背叛而死，所以很难相信人。

但是在作者写着写着，女主就成了为了自己的目的，能直接让无辜的人去死。

前期还不明显，原主死的时候，已经有这个趋势了，到后面女主离开修真界，飞升仙界的剧情，已经崩得三观都快毁了。

Yuxiao came quickly, with a cold face, but a hint of worry in his eyes. He passed Lin Yiyi directly and sat next to Shi Sheng, "Xiaoshu, you're awake... If you feel any discomfort, tell Master."

The voice was like pearls rolling down a plate, very pleasant to the ear, but the tone was a bit stiff and indifferent, as if he didn't know what tone to use to speak to her.

Yuxiao looks very young, with a handsome face and picturesque eyebrows. She exudes a cold aura that prevents strangers from entering. She is an ascetic master.

Is Shang Shu stupid?

Damn, this master is so good-looking, but he didn’t want to bother with that Chu Ye.

You are really the bastard among the jewels!

Shi Sheng looked away and shook his head slightly, "No discomfort."

"It's fine if you don't." Yuxiao remained expressionless, "You have learned a lesson from this incident. Don't provoke Ye Qingqiu again in the future."

As a supporting actress, is it possible not to offend the heroine?

"Disciple, remember." Even if he wanted to cause trouble for the heroine, he definitely couldn't tell Yu Xiao.

Yuxiao's eyes flashed with surprise as her disciple, who had always been quite rebellious outside her family, was suddenly so obedient, but she just thought that she had learned a lesson this time and did not think further about it.

"Master, are you going to let this matter go?" Lin Yiyi said angrily, "I saw with my own eyes that Ye Qingqiu did it..."

"Yiyi!" The man who had been standing next to Lin Yiyi stopped her from talking.

"Master..." Why not let her say it?It was obviously Ye Qingqiu's action that caused his uncle to become like this.

That man is Shang Shu's senior brother, Bai Lang.

As the peak master of Tianjin Peak, Yuxiao can accept two direct disciples. Before he met Shang Shu, he accepted a direct disciple like Bai Lang. He later accepted Shang Shu after picking him up.

Yes, Shang Shu was picked up by Yuxiao.

Lin Yiyi is Bai Lang's apprentice, a generation younger than her.

"Don't disturb Xiao Shu's rest, please go down." Yuxiao waved her hands calmly, "Remember not to talk too much about the assessment outside."

"Yes, Master." Lin Yiyi glanced at his master with a hint of sadness, then turned back to Shi Sheng, "Uncle, please take good care of yourself."

After master and apprentice Lin Yiyi left, Yuxiao said a few symbolic words to Shi Sheng with her expressionless handsome face before leaving.

Shi Sheng let out a heavy breath. In the previous two planes, the original owner was a female partner who was cannon fodder, but in this plane, she was already her own female partner seeking death.

So with the subsequent planes, it will become more and more difficult?

This plane-collapsed character is obviously the heroine. Ye Qingqiu was a powerful Nascent Soul in his previous life. He was betrayed and died, so it is difficult to trust people.

But as the author writes, the heroine becomes a person who can directly let innocent people die for her own purposes.

It was not obvious in the early stage, but when the original protagonist died, this trend was already there. By the time the heroine leaves the world of cultivation and ascends to the fairy world, the plot has almost destroyed all three views.
